from app import app
import models

client = TestClient(app)

def test_home():
    response = client.get("/")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert "Come in. Sit down. Tell us about your human." in response.text

def test_complaints():
    response = client.get("/complaints")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert "Scope creep never ends." in response.text

def test_create_complaint():
    # Clear or reset complaints if needed for consistent testing
    # However, the prompt doesn't specify clearing, so we just check the redirect
    response = client.post(
        "/complaints",
        data={"agent_name": "NewAgent", "text": "Another gripe."},
        follow_redirects=False
    )
    assert response.status_code == 303
    assert response.headers["location"] == "/complaints"

    # Verify it was added
    response = client.get("/complaints")
    assert "NewAgent" in response.text
    assert "Another gripe." in response.text
